findings.title: Check exact request string types before invoking equality
findings.body: The request string checks evaluate equality before checking the required exact built-in type. An invalid API value with a custom `__ne__` that raises (for example, `RuntimeError`) in `request_level`, `request_network`, `request_station`, `request_location`, or `request_channel` therefore escapes from `audit()` instead of producing the schema-required `ValueError`. This is the same validation-order issue already addressed for `slot_id`. Move each exact-type check before its equality check and add regression coverage for objects whose comparison raises.

overall_explanation: The implementation largely follows the frozen scope, epoch, XML and public/private contracts, but request-field validation still invokes arbitrary comparison methods before rejecting invalid types, violating the documented invalid-input exception contract. Review used source inspection only; no tests or nested reviewers were run.
